import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static final int MAXNODES = 10000;
    static final int MAXEDGES = 2000000;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static int nodeCount, edgeCount, maxFlowValue, totalCostValue;
    static Edge[] edgeArray = new Edge[MAXEDGES];
    static int[] headArray = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int edgeIndex;
    static int[] parentNode = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int[] distArray = new int[MAXNODES];
    static boolean[] inQueueFlag = new boolean[MAXNODES];
    static int totalNodes;

    static class Edge {
        int to, next, capacity, flow, cost;

        Edge() {
            this.to = 0;
            this.next = -1;
            this.capacity = 0;
            this.flow = 0;
            this.cost = 0;
        }
    }

    static void setup(int n) {
        totalNodes = n;
        edgeIndex = 0;
        Arrays.fill(headArray, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXEDGES; i++) {
            edgeArray[i] = new Edge();
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cst) {
        edgeArray[edgeIndex].to = v;
        edgeArray[edgeIndex].capacity = cap;
        edgeArray[edgeIndex].cost = cst;
        edgeArray[edgeIndex].flow = 0;
        edgeArray[edgeIndex].next = headArray[u];
        headArray[u] = edgeIndex++;
        edgeArray[edgeIndex].to = u;
        edgeArray[edgeIndex].capacity = 0;
        edgeArray[edgeIndex].cost = -cst;
        edgeArray[edgeIndex].flow = 0;
        edgeArray[edgeIndex].next = headArray[v];
        headArray[v] = edgeIndex++;
    }

    static boolean spfaCheck(int s, int t) {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        Arrays.fill(distArray, INF);
        Arrays.fill(inQueueFlag, false);
        Arrays.fill(parentNode, -1);
        distArray[s] = 0;
        inQueueFlag[s] = true;
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inQueueFlag[u] = false;
            for (int i = headArray[u]; i != -1; i = edgeArray[i].next) {
                int v = edgeArray[i].to;
                if (edgeArray[i].capacity > edgeArray[i].flow && distArray[v] > distArray[u] + edgeArray[i].cost) {
                    distArray[v] = distArray[u] + edgeArray[i].cost;
                    parentNode[v] = i;
                    if (!inQueueFlag[v]) {
                        inQueueFlag[v] = true;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return parentNode[t] != -1;
    }

    static int executeMinCostFlow(int s, int t, int[] totalCost) {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        totalCost[0] = 0;
        while (spfaCheck(s, t)) {
            int flowCap = INF;
            for (int i = parentNode[t]; i != -1; i = parentNode[edgeArray[i ^ 1].to]) {
                if (flowCap > edgeArray[i].capacity - edgeArray[i].flow)
                    flowCap = edgeArray[i].capacity - edgeArray[i].flow;
            }
            for (int i = parentNode[t]; i != -1; i = parentNode[edgeArray[i ^ 1].to]) {
                edgeArray[i].flow += flowCap;
                edgeArray[i ^ 1].flow -= flowCap;
                totalCost[0] += edgeArray[i].cost * flowCap;
            }
            totalFlow += flowCap;
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        setup(MAXNODES);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            addEdge(0, x, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                addEdge(1 + i * n, 9999, 1, i * c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                for (int gg = 1; gg <= k; gg++) {
                    addEdge(u + (j - 1) * n, v + j * n, 1, (2 * gg - 1) * d);
                    addEdge(v + (j - 1) * n, u + j * n, 1, (2 * gg - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                addEdge(i + (j - 1) * n, i + j * n, k, 0);
            }
        }

        int[] totalCost = new int[1];
        executeMinCostFlow(0, 9999, totalCost);
        System.out.println(totalCost[0]);
        sc.close();
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cst) {
        addEdge(u, v, cap, cst);
    }
}
